name: WA liminal geometry profile
abstract: Examples and test cases for 2D geometries with described 3D limits.

description:
## 3D Liminal Profile

This building block captures test cases for 2D topology with 3D extent descriptions for WA.

It allows isolation of these from the more general 2D and explicit 3D cases.

Specific validators, transformers and viewers can now be defined for this profile.

examples.title: Authoritative 2D footprint
examples.content:
The surveyed horizontal footprint only. No vertical extent is defined and no derived geometry
has been generated.

This example contains three parcels; two strata lots that have undefined vertical extents that 
are to be extinguished, and a conventional 2D parcel that is created by the survey (with 
undefined vertical extents).

Point coordinates are 2D only.

![2D Footprint Example](https://surroundaustralia.github.io/3d-csdm-profile-wa/assets/2d-footprint.png)

examples.title: 2.5D reference surface
examples.content:
The footprint is associated with a ground reference surface. The surface provides vertical
context but is not a legal vertical boundary, so `verticalExtent.status` remains `notApplicable`.

Point coordinates are 3D.

This is the same dataset used in the [2D Footprint Example](2d-footprint), except a reference 
surface (ground surface in this instance) has been included.

![2.5D reference surface](https://surroundaustralia.github.io/3d-csdm-profile-wa/assets/2-5d-reference-surface.png)

examples.title: Relative height description
examples.content:
Both vertical boundaries are described relative to ground level but cannot yet be resolved to
absolute values, so `resolutionStatus` is `requiresReferenceSurface`.

This is the same dataset used in the [2D Footprint Example](2d-footprint), along with a spatial 
representation describing boundary offsets from ground level. A ground surface is not provided
in this example.

![Relative height description](https://surroundaustralia.github.io/3d-csdm-profile-wa/assets/height-described-relative.png)

examples.title: Absolute AHD height description
examples.content:
Both vertical boundaries are supported by absolute values referenced to the AHD vertical datum 
(EPSG:5711), so `computabilityStatus` is `computable`, but in this example, has not been included in 
the 3D CSDM.

As absolute heights are defined, `zMin` and `zMax` are populated.

![Absolute (AHD) height description](https://surroundaustralia.github.io/3d-csdm-profile-wa/assets/height-defined.png)

examples.title: Jurisdictionally bounded height description
examples.content:
Similar to **Relative Height Description** above. However, the vertical boundary is established by title, 
Crown Grant, statute or by another jurisdictional authority, as opposed to _by survey_ in the **Relative 
Height Description** example.

In this example only a lower vertical extent is defined (commonly resulting from a WA Crown Grant).

![Jurisdictionally bounded height description](https://surroundaustralia.github.io/3d-csdm-profile-wa/assets/jurisdictionally-bounded.png)
